text: If you are thinking about suicide or self-harm, please reach out now: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, US), or find local helplines at befrienders.org (Befrienders Worldwide) or findahelpline.com. What follows are scholarly summaries of how traditions have discussed this topic - it is not counseling, and it is no substitute for talking to someone.

This material summarizes how religious and philosophical traditions have discussed end-of-life questions. It is not medical advice. Decisions about care belong with you, your family, and qualified clinicians.
This material describes moral teachings, not the law of any jurisdiction. It is not legal advice; for legal questions consult a qualified professional.
